name: Project Launch
description: Kicks off a project: the driving question, why it matters, milestones, team roles, how it will be assessed, and questions before starting.
audience: Project-based learning, capstones, science fair and group projects.

slides.guidance: A title for the {topic} project, with a subtitle like 'Project brief · {grade}'.
The driving question of the project, and what students will make or show.
The milestones with rough dates or weeks, from start to presentation.
How teams work: size, roles, and the first task to start today.
How the project is assessed: 3 to 5 clear criteria.
Questions students should answer before they start planning.
What to do first, what is due when, where to get help.
